svg.text: Literature-qualified topology → mission-constrained 2U concept → fixed-versus-gimballed link result
• Measured S-parameters / AR / pattern + environmental qualification
Exact study frequency · CP topology · measured RF data · qualification evidence
Our antenna is not a copy: 60 × 60 × 7 mm is a new packaging target
that requires full-wave re-optimization and hardware measurement.
2.205 GHz · 384,400 km · 5 W RF · 5.2 dBic target · 4 kbps · G/T 22 dB/K assumed · 3 dB reserve
LINK HEADROOM AFTER REQUIRED 3 dB RESERVE
Fixed antenna: boresight rotates with lander
Current 65° green-zone case is hull-blocked. Gimbal restores pointing gain; mount/FOV optimization is still required.
Power: lander DC only; transceiver/PA + heater onboard. 5 W RF assumes 14.29 W PA DC; worst-case branch incl. 30 W heater = 52.11 W.
[1] Sánchez-Sevilleja et al., Sensors 25(4), 1237, 2025, Fig. 5(d), doi:10.3390/s25041237. Image adapted from the cited work.
Team result: reduced-order link model · antenna EM/VNA/chamber validation pending
